# T3Code replay provenance

Recorded from isolated T3Code 0.1.7 / protocol 2 at the contract pin in
vendor/t3-contracts/VERSION.md. The fixture writer created idle threads only, with
synthetic provider IDs, model names and titles. No provider turn or approval ran.
Local test workspace paths were replaced with C:/capri-test. No token or environment
credential is included. t3-shell.json includes authoritative and repository-metadata
snapshots plus synchronized; metadata snapshots must not erase the thread list.
t3-projection.json is an idle thread projection used for boundary tests. Tests add
explicit synthetic pending items to it, without claiming these came from a provider.
